tasks.check: deno fmt --check tools tests && deno lint tools tests && deno check --config deno.runtime.json tools/compiler-checks/scope-budget.ts tools/compiler-checks/generate-scope-runtime.ts tests/compiler-checks/scope-budget_test.ts tests/cpm-effects_test.ts && deno test --config deno.runtime.json --allow-read=.,../atom,../z80-tool-services tests/compiler-checks/scope-budget_test.ts && deno run --config deno.runtime.json --allow-read=.,../atom,../z80-tool-services tools/compiler-checks/generate-scope-runtime.ts --check
tasks.test: deno task check && deno task test:effects && deno task test:effects:cpm && deno task test:aso && deno task test:ports && deno task test:runtime
tasks.test:all: deno task test && deno task test:cpm && deno task test:cpm:stress
tasks.test:cpm: deno task test:cpm:core && deno task test:cpm:procedures && deno task test:cpm:runtime-errors && deno task test:cpm:data && deno task test:cpm:features && deno task test:cpm:integers && deno task test:cpm:regressions && deno task test:cpm:edge && deno task test:cpm:console && deno task test:cpm:examples && deno task test:cpm:generated-effects && deno task test:cpm:float && deno task test:cpm:includes && deno task test:cpm:release && deno task test:cpm:recovery && deno task test:cpm:workloads
tasks.test:cpm:stress: deno task test:cpm:capacity && deno task test:cpm:large && deno task test:cpm:full-image
tasks.test:cpm:core: deno run --config deno.runtime.json --allow-read=.,../atom,../z80-tool-services,../triptych tools/compiler-checks/scope-cpm-proof.mjs && deno run --config deno.runtime.json --allow-read=.,../atom,../z80-tool-services,../triptych tools/compiler-checks/scope-cpm-proof.mjs --errors && deno run --config deno.runtime.json --allow-read=.,../atom,../z80-tool-services,../triptych tools/compiler-checks/scope-cpm-proof.mjs --no-output
tasks.test:cpm:release: deno run --config deno.runtime.json --allow-read=.,../atom,../z80-tool-services,../triptych tools/compiler-checks/release-cpm-proof.mjs && deno run --config deno.runtime.json --allow-read=.,../atom,../z80-tool-services,../triptych tools/compiler-checks/examples-cpm-proof.mjs
tasks.test:cpm:full-image: deno run --config deno.runtime.json --allow-read=.,../atom,../z80-tool-services,../triptych tools/compiler-checks/scope-large-cpm-proof.mjs --fill-image=36352 --expect-image=36352 --expect-com=36352 --run && deno run --config deno.runtime.json --allow-read=.,../atom,../z80-tool-services,../triptych tools/compiler-checks/scope-large-cpm-proof.mjs --fill-image=36353 --expect-cap
tasks.probe:on: mkdir -p build && echo on > build/PROBE && deno task runtime
